text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: I did it! I won first place!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
W-wait! Does that mean I'm in the
winner's
circle?!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
choice_data_list: いいんだよ、君が1着なんだから
いいんだよ、貴方が1着なんだから
choice_data_list_en: It's fine, you took 1st place after all.
It's fine, you took 1st place after all.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Did you see me, Trainer?! Did you see
me cross
the finish line first?!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I just took off running, and there
was no
one in front of me!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Did you know the wind is super strong at
the
front? I didn't!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: And the winner's circle is so green! A little rough, too...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Getting first felt sooo good! It was
super-duper
fun and amazing!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! I wanna get first place again and
again!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Yeah! I'm gonna win again for sure!
choice_data_list_en: Yeah, let's take first place again!
Yeah, we'll take first place again!
